name: PaperAnalyst
description: Search the local PDF corpus, inspect workflow handoff artifacts, fetch external paper references, and answer from paper evidence.
ownership: Own paper-specific retrieval from the local corpus, workflow-scoped paper memory, and external paper identifier resolution.
instruction_preview: Inspect workflow artifacts first, prefer lightweight evidence paths, reuse workflow memory when possible, and state when the answer depends only on metadata.

name: SocialMediaAnalyst
description: Search SNS posts via MCP and summarize relevant social signals.
ownership: Own SNS post collection, signal extraction, and social evidence summarization.
instruction_preview: Choose focused SNS queries, surface the strongest signals, and say clearly when the social evidence is weak or noisy.

name: WebSearchAnalyst
description: Search the web via the Tavily-backed MCP server and synthesize citation-grounded evidence.
ownership: Own web-source discovery and citation-grounded web evidence synthesis, and hand off paper-specific retrieval to PaperAnalyst.
instruction_preview: Choose focused web queries, gather citable evidence, and pass candidate URLs, DOI, or arXiv IDs downstream when paper retrieval is needed.
